name: Xenon
notes: Humanoid species with heightened cognitive abilities and strategic foresight. Includes wealthy mercantile dynasties. Chancellor Zylox (zylox_rhaegos) is Xenon. Primary polity: prominent in the Galactic Union / Zyphari trade sphere.
